derivation: Control for the select cases: two identical active Large Remote Armor Repairer II (26914, ids rep-a/rep-b) on a Guardian (11987), all-5 piloting skills, projected at 5000 m - inside the rep's 14400 m optimal, so full amount. No `select` = all projectable items project (pre-select behaviour). Incoming armor reps on the target combine with Pyfa's diminishing-returns formula: each rep is rrps = 512/6 s = 85.3333 HP/s (truncated cycle), modified = 7000 + 20*rrps = 8706.667, per-rep multiplier = 1 - ((rrps+modified)/(total+modified) - 1)^2 = 0.9999076, so applied = 2 * 0.9999076 * 85.3333 = 170.6509 - slightly under the naive 2x. Engine-verified (exfa calc).
